Priya K.: Quick question — we want to share a small set of debug logs with the product team for a usability bug. Are we allowed to share unredacted logs internally? :thinking:
Devon (SRE): short answer: depends. If logs contain PII (emails, user_ids that map to real people) we need redaction or an access approval.
Alex M.: what counts as PII here? user_id hashes vs plain emails?
Devon (SRE): hashed IDs are OK if irreversible. Plain emails or phone numbers are PII. Also watch for free-text that might include full names or account numbers.
Priya K.: got it. These logs have email addresses (dev@example.com) and some stack traces. Is masking emails with `<REDACTED_EMAIL>` enough for sharing in #product?
Devon (SRE): masking is fine for product channel, but we prefer to use the internal redaction script so audit trail shows it was redacted. Do not paste original logs anywhere public.
Nina (PM): if we run the redaction script, does it preserve timestamps and error codes so we can triage?
Devon (SRE): yes — redaction preserves metadata fields like `timestamp`, `error_code`, `request_id`. Only sensitive text blobs are sanitized. Example:```redact --input logs.json --output logs.redacted.json --preserve-fields timestamp,error_code,request_id```
security-bot: Reminder: Per internal data classification policy (link: https://redwood.internal/policy/data-classification) logs with personal data are "Restricted". Sharing requires either redaction or explicit access approval.
Alex M.: if we need approval, what's the fastest route?
Devon (SRE): For small internal shares, do a ticket in #sec-approvals with: purpose, recipients, retention window. Tag @Priya K. as owner. For anything larger or external, escalate to security@redwood.com.
Priya K.: ok I'll run the redaction and post the sanitized file. If we still need anything, I'll open a sec-approval ticket. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Alex M.: quick FYI — please avoid screenshots that include the full console (they sometimes leak emails in user cards). Prefer exported redacted files.
Devon (SRE): also check RBAC: product team members should have view access only. If anyone requests download rights, we need explicit justification.
Priya K.: noted. I'll follow the script and keep this thread updated.
Nina (PM): thanks all — appreciate the quick check! :raised_hands:
